title: Nvidia Investigates CEO Jensen Huang Following Affair Admission
excerpt: Nvidia has started an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang after he informed the board of an intimacy with a Chinese spy.
body_html:
Nvidia has initiated an independent investigation concerning its Chief Executive Officer, Jensen Huang. The inquiry follows a disclosure by Huang to the company's board of directors regarding an intimate relationship with an individual identified as a Chinese spy.

As the review gets underway, the board is looking into the situation, though further details regarding the ongoing process or potential outcomes have not been publicly detailed at this stage.
